Can the mind be free from the mechanism of creating images?

descriptions.Sc-7Dixd2bU:
Audio | J. Krishnamurti - Paris 1965 - Public Talk 5 - The root of contradiction is the division between thinker and thought

We cannot act when there is contradiction within ourselves.

Where there is love, there is also death. The two cannot be separate.

What I am stating has value and meaning only when contradiction totally comes to an end.

Love and death must be for creation to be.

We don’t know how to end sorrow, so we escape through religion or the assertion, ‘Life has no meaning, so just live for today.’

One has to understand life totally.

A mind that is afraid, ambitious, greedy, envious or competitive can never have the energy brought about by action.

Q: What do you mean by self-knowledge?

Q: What is the relation between action and meditation?

To be sane is one of the most difficult things.

A virtue nothing to do with society and its moralities.

Learning about oneself and knowing about oneself are two different things.

Only the meditative mind knows what love is.

Do you know what it is to be aware?

Q: How can we know ourselves without suffering?

Q: When watching a play, one is completely absorbed: is that complete attention?

Q: The knowledge of impermanency brings suffering.

Life is a movement in action and relationship.

The importance of understanding the nature and significance of pleasure.

What place has desire regarding pleasure?

A mind no longer caught in desire or pleasure.

Why is there insistence desire is fulfilled?

Why are we empty?

Change implies order.

Learning is an act in the active present.

We live in fragments.

Is it possible to come into direct contact with a problem?

To be in contact with fear requires understanding the nature of escape.

Q: What can we do to be aware, attentive?

Inquire into the pleasure ambition gives.
